# When should a widow or widower claim the survivor benefit?

> Free Social Security widow(er) and spousal benefit calculator: see the survivor benefit at every age from 60, whether to take survivor first and your own at 70, and a spousal top-up. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
